slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The author's 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation) states that rural primary healthcare clinics in Egypt predominantly keep patient records on paper, in handwritten registers, and that the rural point of service remains paper by default; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: Patient records at rural primary healthcare clinics

facts.fact: The review states that reports of 2024 to 2026 indicate only 314 hospitals in Egypt have EMRs, with public and rural facilities lagging, citing an arXiv paper; no denominator is given and the hospital tier is not distinguished. Dated to the document's published date.

The review cites a 2014 WHO-EMRO study of primary health care units in Alexandria that found electronic records kept in parallel with paper, the paper records more complete and the electronic ones varying widely by unit.
facts.system: Electronic medical information system at Alexandria primary health care units
